description: Source code for the LayerState component in Android's graphics system, defining classes and methods for managing layer states, including serialization/deserialization, merging, diffing, and validation.

classes.name: layer_state_t
classes.description: Represents the state of a graphical layer, including properties like position, size, transformation, and serialization methods.

classes.name: DisplayState
classes.description: Represents the state of a display, including size, orientation, and surface properties.

classes.name: ComposerState
classes.description: Encapsulates the overall composition state, primarily wrapping a layer_state_t.

classes.name: BufferData
classes.description: Holds buffer information for a layer, including buffer handle, fences, and identifiers.

classes.name: TrustedPresentationListener
classes.description: Listener for trusted presentation events, with serialization support.

classes.name: CaptureArgs
classes.description: Arguments for capturing a layer or display, including format, size, and other capture parameters.

classes.name: DisplayCaptureArgs
classes.description: Arguments specific to display capture, extending CaptureArgs with display token and size.

classes.name: LayerCaptureArgs
classes.description: Arguments specific to layer capture, extending CaptureArgs with layer handle and children-only flag.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the object into a Parcel.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a Parcel.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another state object into this one, updating changed properties.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Computes differences between this and another state object.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the state based on permissions, removing unauthorized changes.

methods.name: generateReleaseCallbackId
methods.description: Generates a unique callback ID for buffer release.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes the object data into a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Reads the object data from a Parcel.
